headline: Colonial Toehold Expands in Callahan's Passage Amid Heavy Grinding Clashes
war_summary: Since the morning bulletin, Colonial forces in Callahan's Passage have pushed their presence to two strategic bases, wresting further ground amidst eight rapid base turnovers in two hours concentrated across Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, accompanied by over 2,400 combined casualties. Across the northern perimeter, Palantine Berm flared into fresh action with three base contests logged within the last two hours, centering on Leiri Hermanni. In Weathered Expanse, where the Colonials maintain seven bases and two vacant ruined positions, territorial shifts slowed to a single transition even as furious combat consumed eighteen hundred lives over the past two hours. Fighting along the Stlican Shelf remains contentious with two additional base events up to the latest wire, leaving the sector split between seven Colonial holdings, one Warden bastion, and a solitary neutral shell. Meanwhile, Mooring County endures brutal frontline friction with over a thousand fresh casualties in two hours without altering its twelve-base Warden perimeter, and Nevish Line registered an operational lull in base flips despite rising casualty tempo.
